findings.summary: R1/R2 record labels in ADR-0013 collide with the R1/R2 cost-rule namespace used by cost.md and M1/SPEC.md's cost table; carry as a note in the commit body.
findings.failure_scenario: A reader following M1/SPEC.md's 'R1, R1b' cost row into ADR-0013 reads 'R1' as the bundling cost rule rather than an ADR-local record label, and mis-scopes a later fast-mode cost budget.

findings.summary: M1.17b claims LICENSE/NOTICE were 'delivered by de66330 (M0.4)', but LICENSE and NOTICE are added by this staged commit; de66330's tree contains licenses/ and the licence gate but no root LICENSE or NOTICE.
findings.failure_scenario: A later agent auditing licence compliance greps the M0.4 commit for LICENSE, finds nothing, and either re-adds a duplicate root LICENSE or reopens M1.17b as unfinished.
